sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 960. Success value 100. 3x physical damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Applies Diffusion. The next Ability used will change from a specified single/range target to targeting all (except for certain Abilities).
-Target: all allies. Increases physical and magic attack Ability Power by 100 for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Boosts critical hit Ability Power by 100 for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases physical and magic Ability Power and Critical Assault buff limits by 50 for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Overcast for 60 seconds ([Special] increases max HP by 100%; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special debuffs; nullifies debuffs; increases all elemental defense by 60; recovers 50 Cost. After the effect ends, Time Extend activates and extends the time advantageous effects (buffs, special buffs, and non-removable buffs) are applied to yourself by 60 seconds for one time only.).
-Target: yourself. Applies Time Spirit's Crest for 120 seconds ([Heraldic] Increases max HP by 500%, increases all stats by 50%, increases time elemental attack for all allies by 40, enchants the attacks of all allies with a 25% Star Bane. Only one Heraldic effect may be active at a time (between both allies and enemies). When a new Heraldic effect is activated, the older effect will be removed. This effect is not affected by Time Slice or Time Extend).
-Target: yourself. Applies Flank for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all stats by 100%; [Special] ignores 50% of the target's DEF and MDEF; [Special] permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction: Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases your character's max HP by 100% when equipped in the Main Slot.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 40000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Rage for 150 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
Water and Time Defense from Unison Damage +700
